investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Brightbrook Journeys (travel booking); Platform: on-premises data center DC-A, server range 10.129.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster bright-prod (kubeadm); Database: mysql instance fares-db-01 for fares-svc; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
